name: Extended Review Audit
description: Longer training review package for replay coverage, annotations, audit log review, and export/archive practice.

scenario.name: extended-review-audit-scenario
scenario.description: Simulated multi-contact scenario for longer audit-grade replay reviews.

review_checklist.label: Multiple abstract training actions were recorded.
review_checklist.evidence: Report event_audit.action_stats contains at least two action types.

review_checklist.label: Replay coverage and maximum loaded-window gap were reviewed.
review_checklist.evidence: Console replay quality summary was checked and report snapshot_coverage is present.

review_checklist.label: Instructor annotations were added for review-relevant events.
review_checklist.evidence: Report annotations contains entries linked to event ids or the run.

review_checklist.label: Completed run archive was exported before retention pruning.
review_checklist.evidence: Archive manifest records report exports, events, audit logs, snapshots, and track points.

safety_notice: Training/simulation only. This template does not provide real fire-control, weapon-control, electronic-warfare, radar-control, or tactical engagement guidance.
